description.value: Ripples Winery & New Wave Distilling is a family-run estate on 12 acres of organic blueberry fields in the Fraser Valley, combining a winery and craft distillery in a lush garden setting with ponds, tropical plants, and shaded patios. The operation produces organic blueberry wines, BC grape wines, and handcrafted small-batch spirits—gins, vodkas, rums, and liqueurs—all from locally grown or sourced ingredients. Touring cyclists can settle into covered or open-air patio seating for a flight, a craft cocktail, or small bites in what the owners describe as a serene garden oasis.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website was successfully fetched and provides detailed content about the winery's garden setting, cocktail lounge, small bites, and products. The website footer clearly shows the address as '3387 Tolmie Road Abbotsford, BC V3G 2T9', which contradicts the OSM community tag of 'Chilliwack'; the street number matches but the municipality does not. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in any OSM tags, so all such fields are null.

Phone number (+1-604-864-1033) is listed in OSM but does not appear anywhere on the fetched website content; only an email (events@rippleswinery.com) is shown. Phone cannot be confirmed.

The community/municipality discrepancy (OSM: Chilliwack; website: Abbotsford) also needs resolution before publishing.
